“I was called to tell this story (the Gospel). I never tire of telling it. I never tire of improving my telling of it. I love my calling.”

— Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen, Anécdota citada por el Cardenal Tagle en la homilía de beatificación (2026)

Via Vatican News, 24 September 2026
